metadata.title: Finite group actions on nonpositively curved 3-manifolds
metadata.abstract: We show that every orientation-preserving action of a finite group on a closed nonpositively curved 3-manifold preserves a nonpositively curved metric.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
